description: When a provider value changes, every component reading that context re-renders, even inside `memo`.
Separate contexts for data that is read by different components or changes at different rates (user vs cart).
A context holding only stable functions, so components that only dispatch never re-render on data changes.
`<Profiler id onRender>` reports every commit of its subtree with the phase and timings; useful for render-count assertions.
A function that picks a slice of state so a subscriber re-renders only when that slice changes. Context has none; stores do.
